programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚。

programme.title: E1 - 入廠名額爭奪戰開啟
programme.desc: 由周杰倫擔當音樂造夢者，召集夢想生活官劉畊宏和夢想見證官王鶴棣，及四組廠牌經理人GAI周延&布瑞吉Bridge、歐陽靖&小鬼王琳凱、艾熱&早安、VaVa&盛宇，一同為說唱新生代們的追夢之旅保駕護航；打破傳統導師帶隊模式，通過構建真實師徒關系，共同打造獨具特色的說唱廠牌；透過競演激發說唱歌手創作才華，在全民中尋找下一個說唱巨星。

programme.title: E34 - 誠意滿滿 送上專屬告白
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》回歸經典規則。男嘉賓登場後，將通過「愛之請回答」「愛之再判斷」「愛之終決選」三個環節與24位女嘉賓互相了解，還有根據大數據匹配的「智推女生」參與最終決選。陳銘、黃瀾加盟「非誠合夥人」，以全新視角解讀愛情。

programme.title: E73
programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚。

programme.title: E4 - 冉瑩穎鄒市明雙向告白
programme.desc: 以「姐姐當家，愛是什麼」為主題，集結杜華、房主任、冉瑩穎、小鹿、徐夢桃五位當家姐姐，以更加豐富的人生樣本回應當代女性共同面對的生活課題；觀察團成員李維嘉、倪萍、倪子君、張泉靈回歸，共同組成多元觀察體系，從專業視角與大眾視角出發，共同尋找愛是什麼的答案。

programme.title: Understand The World, One Story At A Time
programme.desc: Our deep dive format explains the stories that matter - with clarity, context and journalistic rigor. Each segment goes beyond the headlines to uncover what's driving key developments around the world, featuring sharp analysis, expert voices and exclusive on the ground insights from where events are unfolding.

programme.title: From Myth To Modernity: Africa Reimagines Tradition
programme.desc: Afrimaxx takes a look behind the scenes of a new ballet production which blends mythology with Amapiano. Across Africa, young creatives are reinterpreting cultural heritage in ways that bridge the past and the present.

programme.title: From Competition To Combat
programme.desc: Athletes in the Baltic states are combining elite sports with military service as Russia's war in Ukraine reshapes regional security. The line between competitor and defender is increasingly blurred.

programme.title: Can Scientists Breed The Perfect Strawberry?
programme.desc: Why do many strawberries taste less flavorful today, and can scientists bring back their aroma? We explore the quest for the perfect strawberry, along with new ways to cut food waste and create more sustainable foods.

programme.title: The Sacred Cows Of The Mafia
programme.desc: In the southern Italian region of Calabria, in the municipality of Cittanova, hundreds of feral cattle are causing trouble. They're eating crops and causing accidents. The problem is a relic of the great Mafia wars and a legacy of the 'Ndrangheta clan.

programme.title: Self-Optimization - Which Hacks And Gadgets Are Worth The Hype?
programme.desc: Track your sleep, optimize your diet, boost your performance. Millions are chasing a better, healthier life. But when does self-improvement become an obsession? We put today's biggest trends to the test.

programme.title: From Competition To Combat
programme.desc: Athletes in the Baltic states are combining elite sports with military service as Russia's war in Ukraine reshapes regional security. The line between competitor and defender is increasingly blurred.

programme.title: 9/11 - The Day That Changed The World - Part 1

programme.title: E15
programme.desc: 刑警何遠航（潘粵明 飾）與其徒弟冉方旭（王鶴棣 飾）調查一起涉及徐家父女的神秘失蹤案。1997年，二人在元龍里小區電梯口失蹤，冉方旭最初認定案件為惡意逃債，但2006年，徐父的遺體被意外發現，推翻了這一結論。 近十年後，何遠航的女兒、已成為警察的何曉荷（任敏 飾）發現案件與過往線索的關聯。她與父親聯手，欲在小區拆遷前夕最終揭露真相。

programme.title: E3
programme.desc: 日本現任首相武藤泰山原本打算退出政壇，結果再次發生「變身」意外，但今次交換的對象並非他的兒子，而是與普通國民交換身體，離奇的故事就此展開…！

E2 - Ocean Voyagers
programme.desc: Navigate the ocean’s vast distances, depths, and darkness with nomadic sharks that thrive in the blue emptiness. Meet a lone blue shark traversing stormy Atlantic seas, and hundreds of hammerheads returning to their Pacific island breeding ground.

programme.title: E3 - In the Extreme
programme.desc: Follow a host of sharks with extraordinary abilities that allow them to thrive in the most adverse conditions around the globe. Observe nearly blind Greenland sharks made for life in freezing Arctic waters, and another species that can walk on land.

programme.title: E2 - A Friend in Need
programme.desc: Meet more Amazing Animal Friends including Charlotte, a schnauzer who enjoys bath time with her guinea pig pal Wallace, and a randy ram called Hamish who likes to sneak off to live with a herd of dairy cows instead of his own kind.

programme.title: E1 - Humpback Birth of a Giant
programme.desc: Follow the first months of a newborn humpback whale’s life in the waters off the Pacific Coast of Columbia. See how his mother nurtures him through sickness, supports his body, protects him under attack, and prepares him for an epic journey.

programme.title: E3 - Realm of the Spectacled Bear
programme.desc: Get to know South America’s only bear species. Witness the shy and charismatic spectacled bear play, forage, and look for mates at the secluded Chaparri Ecological Reserve in Northern Peru.

programme.title: E2 - Blood and Dust
programme.desc: Discover the clever way elephants dig wells, and see the relief that comes with a sudden river-filling downpour. Mourn cheetah Kuleta’s loss after lions kill one of her cubs, and get a front-row seat when wild dog Phoenix faces off with a hyena mob.

programme.title: E4 - Deadly Deeds
programme.desc: Deploy biochemical weaponry with nature’s most cunning and resilient fighters. Unleash venomous bites with Komodo dragons, resist poisonous foes with mongoose mobs, and see birds use bone-crushing force to counter poisonous attacks.

programme.title: E3 - Into the Darkness
programme.desc: Stay up late as the northern team attaches an activity tag to a bull shark and finds out what this night owl does after sunset. Then dive 80 meters deep with the southern team, who are hoping to put a satellite tracker on a female great white.

programme.title: Premium Spectacular: 'The Smoke of War Has Not Yet Cleared—A Global Observation of Counterterrorism in the Post-9/11 Era
programme.desc: Twenty-five years ago, a civilian airliner hijacked by Al-Qaeda crashed into the American mainland. The steel and concrete of industrial civilization collapsed in flames, and a terrorist attack that shocked the world rewrote the course of the 21st century. Twenty-five years later, the Twin Towers of the World Trade Center stand as two pools of water, like two scars branded into the heart of New York. Since the complete withdrawal of US troops from Afghanistan, the traditional 'war on terror' seems to have come to an end. However, the shadow of terrorism has not dissipated; it is now spreading across the global security landscape in a more covert, decentralized, and destructive form.

programme.title: E3
programme.desc: 從事心理健康指導工作的劉瑕路遇一名男子想要跳樓，劉瑕見狀便用心理學知識進行疏導，最後成功將該男子救下。這一幕恰巧被正想將自己的心理推理小說改編成劇本的作家祁連山目睹，便力邀劉瑕當顧問。為實現幫助更多人的理想，劉瑕成立了自己的工作室，以出色的專業水準和共情能力，為因事業、家庭或情感問題感到心理壓力的來訪者排憂解困，幫助他們恢復健康積極的生活。祁連山的小說在改編成影視劇的過程中得到了劉瑕的專業指導。隨著兩人接觸不斷加深，他深深地被劉瑕吸引。劉瑕工作之餘，與天才極客沈欽合作開發AI心理測試系統，並將之應用於兒童及社區公益，效果極佳。祁連山也逐漸參與到劉瑕的公益事業中，一起幫助那些面臨生活挑戰的人走出心理困境。二人在一次次攜手合作中越走越近，最終在各自事業都取得成功的同時，也收穫了美好的愛情。

programme.title: E1
programme.desc: 2035年，與人類形象無異的仿生人由於發展過快，引發公眾的擔憂。“明眸”組織專門負責仿生人案件，組員程諾頭腦冷靜，安秋善於共情，面對仿生人不斷被害，兩人聯手揭開謎團。眾生煙火，仿生人間。人類和仿生人的命運都正在被悄悄改寫......

programme.desc: 一個厭世新鮮人意外進入監獄成為管理員，同時監獄也有一群迫不得已在此工作的夥伴，每天面臨各種光怪陸離的遭遇。

programme.title: E27
programme.desc: 講述了大學畢業三年後，羅豔（李庚希飾）經媽媽介紹進入一家離家不遠的傳統型公司做閒差，別人羨慕她輕鬆悠閒，她卻厭倦了枯燥的生活；出入高檔寫字樓的姜小果（卜冠今飾）實際上每天加班沒有自己的生活；突如其來的家庭經濟危機讓段家寶（董思怡飾）從「富二代」變成了「負二代」；梁爽（關曉彤飾）成了全網頂尖的美妝護膚主播，但她的事業起起伏伏。儘管生活的路總是令人困惑而踟躕，但女孩們從不停止向前的腳步。這是充滿艱難，也充滿光明的25歲。

programme.title: E38
programme.desc: 人生進入瓶頸期的職場精英梁友安和習慣了坐冷板凳的運動員宋三川，因緣際會加入了一個草臺網球俱樂部。他們一個是半路出家的俱樂部經理人，一個是羽毛球轉網球的運動員，兩人和隊友們克服困難共同奮戰，努力打造一個了不起的職業俱樂部。在此過程中，梁友安和宋三川逐漸萌生愛意，也面臨著來自觀念和閱歷的衝突。俱樂部不斷髮展，他們在一次次應對挑戰中超越自我、加強信任，最終收穫職業成長和美好愛情。

programme.title: E4 - Thailand
programme.desc: In the most action packed trip yet, Rooftop and Catfish’s trip to Thailand has them face to face with the country’s nature. They wrestle a crocodile, charm a cobra, and get a massage from an elephant that’s somehow more relaxing than the traditional Thai massages they tried out. The two even attempt to catch (cooked) flying chickens on their heads. Things relaxed in Thailand for a moment when the BMX bikers got to balance out this animal packed experience with the spiritual side of the country, each getting Sak Yant, a traditional Thai tattoo. However, the relaxation was short-lived as Catfish and Rooftops’s final battle in Thailand requires them to make it out of a May Thai boxing match alive.
